_comment: This repo's CLI and verbs (PLAN-architecture.md §12.1), and its one store: the assurance ledger (PLAN-architecture.md §6a, §9 step 6), a dynamic SQLite store written only by `checks ledger` (checkslib/ledger.py, accessor's `impl`), gitignored under state/. `list` and `writers` are the read verbs: `run`/`all`/`one`/`fixtures` run checks (repro among them), so they are not declared here; `stores` and `tools` read but walk the whole workspace, which repro would do twice pre-commit, so they are not declared either; `practices` runs the checks its rows name across the whole workspace (and `--import`/`--lower` write gates.json and the baseline), so it is not a read verb; `ledger` writes its store (record, justify) and its `show` reads git live (staleness), so it is not one either.

not_exported.state/ledger.db: not exported yet: its runs are re-derived by each repo's `dev.sh check` (a local cache of git and the checks), but its justifications are authored records that live only here until the hub view (PLAN-architecture.md §9 step 7) settles what the data repo holds; `checks ledger export --out` writes the static export (TODO.md "Assurance ledger")
